title: Global sections over a strictly henselian local scheme are the stalk at the closed point
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a strictly henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with closed point $s$, and let $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ be a geometric point lying over $s$ [def-weil-geometric-point] ($\Omega$ any algebraically closed field with a map $\kappa\to\Omega$). For every abelian sheaf $F$ on $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] the germ map $F(S)\to F_{\bar s}$, $a\mapsto a_{\bar s}$, sending a global section to its class at the pointed etale neighbourhood $(S,\bar s)$ in the stalk of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], is an isomorphism of abelian groups, natural in $F$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03QO (lemma-vanishing-etale-cohomology-strictly-henselian), the statement Gamma(S,F) = F_sbar and its proof: for a pointed etale neighbourhood (U,ubar) of sbar and an affine open Spec A of U containing the image u of ubar, R -> A is etale and kappa(u) = kappa(s) (kappa(u) is finite separable over the separably closed kappa(s)); by Theorem Tag 04GG (theorem-henselian in etale-cohomology.tex, condition (8)/(10)) A = R x A' compatibly with the maps to the residue field, giving a section S -> U through ubar; hence (S,sbar) is cofinal (initial among neighbourhoods, as an index of the colimit) and the germ map is bijective. The proof works verbatim for any algebraically closed Omega over kappa, since the section sends sbar to ubar (both lie over u and induce the same map kappa(u)=kappa(s) -> Omega). DAG nodes for the section: lem-weil-pbc-henselian-local-root-lifting (i)=>(ii) and lem-weil-pbc-root-lifting-etale-retraction.

proof.text: Naturality is Point.toPresheafFiber_naturality applied to the underlying presheaf morphism. Use Mathlib Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff' and Point.toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective to reduce bijectivity to pointed sections of each etale neighbourhood. The forgetful functor on AddCommGrpCat preserves filtered colimits; shrink its colimit universes to u.

For an etale X -> Spec R and marked a : Spec Omega -> X, use the private pointed-section helper with the strict henselian structure supplied explicitly; its affine localization and weakly etale argument constructs the section.

Set Bq = Localization.AtPrime q. The maps R -> B and B -> Bq are weakly etale, hence so is R -> Bq. Since q lies over the maximal ideal, R -> Bq is a local homomorphism. Apply the proved Olivier local weakly etale isomorphism theorem to obtain er : R equiv Bq. Put psi = er.symm composed with B -> Bq; then psi composed with phi is identity.

The ring map chi : B -> Omega representing l sends every element outside q to a unit. Extend it by the localization universal property to chiq : Bq -> Omega. Its composite with R -> Bq equals the ring map theta of s. Therefore theta composed with psi equals chi. Applying Spec and composing with the affine chart gives sigma with sigma followed by X -> Spec R equal to identity, and s followed by sigma equal to the prescribed marked point.

For injectivity, equality of two global germs becomes equality after restriction to some pointed neighbourhood Y, by Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff'. Restrict again along the pointed section Spec R -> Y just constructed. The resulting endomorphism of the identity etale object is identity, since it is over Spec R; hence the two original sections agree. For surjectivity, represent any germ by a section on a pointed neighbourhood X using Point.toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective. Restrict along its pointed section and use Point.toPresheafFiber_w_apply to recover the germ. ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective then gives the claimed isomorphism.

split_report.summary: Split along Stacks 03QO into seven steps: (1) the germ map is the coprojection at (S,sbar) and is natural (elementary); (2) affine chart Spec A of a pointed etale neighbourhood (U,ubar) through u via lem-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhood-affine-shrink, ring map phi: R -> A etale, q over m; (3) kappa -> kappa(q) finite separable (lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-residue-field-separable) hence an isomorphism (lem-pc-sepclosed-finite-sep-trivial, a generic tool lemma of unit sk-prop-picard-dense-points; Mathlib IsSepClosed.algebraMap_surjective); (4) retraction tau: A -> R with tau^-1(m)=q by lem-weil-pbc-henselian-local-root-lifting (i)=>(ii) and lem-weil-pbc-root-lifting-etale-retraction (Stacks 04GG); (5) section sigma = j o Spec tau with sigma(s)=u (elementary); (6) sigma o sbar = ubar via the field-map description of geometric points, written out (elementary); (7) (S,sbar) is a full subcategory with only the identity endomorphism receiving maps to every object of the cofiltered category of neighbourhoods, so lem-weil-pbc-colimit-initial-full-subcategory (1) and lem-weil-pbc-colimit-constant-connected-diagram give that the germ map is an isomorphism; the explicit surjectivity/injectivity argument is recorded too. Statement kept (the sheaf condition is not used: it holds for presheaves). Three more Mathlib searches recorded; no new nodes. No Lean in slopmaster2 states it.
